# Status.io synthetic saved responses

Fields are written from the published examples at https://developer.status.io/openapi.json, read 23 October 2026. Identifiers are synthetic-lamp values. Files use the documented status/result envelope, component/container examples, status summary, deprecated incident list, maintenance ID enumeration, maintenance detail and IP access lists. Message lifecycle/status numbers use the corresponding documented write-operation dictionaries; their use on GET messages is an explicit inference. Fewer than 100 legacy incidents is treated as below the documented cap; 100 is refused because completeness cannot be established.

No subscriber response shape, modern incident pagination terminator, postmortem/template field, source creation time or public incident permalink is invented. Those gaps are recorded in MOVE-007. No provider account was used. The fixture has no operator addresses, credentials or provider identifiers.
